*Sikkhaṁpaccācikkhaṇa* (“Renouncing the training in anger”) is the tenth *saṅghādisesa* rule of the *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* in the Vinaya Piṭaka. The rule addresses the disciplinary offense incurred when a Buddhist nun persistently declares in anger that she will renounce the training and join another religious tradition; such conduct warrants formal suspension by the community (*saṅghādisesa*). A complete English translation of the rule and its commentary is provided by Bhikkhu Brahmali.
